CNN, which is owned by Warner Bros. Discovery

, said that the White House informed the network its staff would not be allowed on Air Force One on Saturday as the president flies to Knoxville, Tenn., for a college football game between Tennessee and Texas.
The network was selected to cover the travel as part of its role in the White House press pool until the Trump administration told CNN on Friday night it would be barred.
No other news outlet was named to take CNN's place, so there will be no television news coverage of the Tennessee trip.
The decision comes after the administration initially
an order given by a federal judge on Sept. 24 mandating that reporters from CNN, MS Now
, and Politico have their White House credentials restored. They were allowed back on the grounds later in the day.

title: CNN barred from travelling with Trump on Air Force One on Saturday
